verdict.rationale: The quickstart has users clone a public GitHub repository (github.com/airweave-ai/airweave) and self-host it, so the source is readable. Docs invite contributing connectors back to the community, and a community comment places Airweave in the open-source AI space. missing for 10: an explicitly named open-source license (e.g., MIT/Apache) in the evidence, first-party statement of open-source status.
